mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines over the horizon, or returns are negative despite the decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% triggers a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as higher interest rates dampen growth expectations.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% but SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate coupled with rising industrial production signals accommodative policy and strong demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls AND INDPRO rises in the same month
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS falls AND INDPRO rises in the same month, but SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained increase in the federal funds rate predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced growth prospects.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) during a tightening cycle when FEDFUNDS rises, or returns are negative outside the tightening regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in HOUST (demand) above 900 units triggers positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as increased demand boosts market confidence.
failure_condition: HOUST crosses above 900 but SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in HOUST (demand) and GDPC1 (GDP) indicate robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both HOUST and GDPC1 rise in the same month
failure_condition: Both HOUST and GDPC1 rise in the same month, but SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below 100 signals weak supply conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as market uncertainty grows.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 100 but SPX 60d returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with rising federal funds rates (tightening) predicts negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as supply-demand mismatch intensifies.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls AND FEDFUNDS rises in the same month
failure_condition: INDPRO falls AND FEDFUNDS rises in the same month, but SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05).
